information.description:
The newest members of the VDB often lack training and quality gear, but they’re numerous and easy to replace. The one thing they do have is marginal neural reinforcement from the gang’s stockpile, making them a little more dangerous for non-VDB netrunners.

From Corgo's 77 Collection: Mooks by Corgopolis (Voodoo Boys).
